The '''Mos Espa Token of Heroism''' was a special award given by the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] to the unlikely group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who brought it upon themselves to aid in the defense of the city during an [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|invasion]] of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] led by their ruthless [[Tusken King|King]].
